checksums.name: header_sum32
checksums.formula_detail: checksum = (sum of 14 little-endian u32 words covering header bytes +0x08..+0x3F) - 1, mod 2^32. The '-1' falls out of the write routine (FUN_08073438) summing the OLD 64-byte header (including the old checksum+complement pair, which always sum to 0xFFFFFFFF for any previously valid header) before overwriting +0x00/+0x04 with the new checksum/complement. complement is stored as the bitwise NOT of checksum.

checksums.name: header_complement
checksums.formula_detail: complement = bitwise NOT of header_sum32 checksum, mod 2^32, stored little-endian. Verified as ~stored_checksum == stored_complement in all 4 header copies.

io_driver_functions.notes: Raw SRAM byte-copy driver: sets WAITCNT-style wait-state bits via a masked OR on a 16-bit global register, then copies strictly one byte at a time, matching the GBA SRAM 8-bit bus requirement.

Called as the post-write verification step inside the retry loop; its own body manipulates unrelated global pointers and calls func_0x0808b890, so its exact verify mechanism is not fully resolved from this workspace (reported as read/verify-adjacent, not a confirmed CRC/compare).
Retry wrapper: calls 0x080052b0 then 0x08005320, up to 3 attempts, breaking early on a zero result.
Fills a 32KB EWRAM mirror buffer with a pattern byte, then conditionally flushes exactly 0x8000 bytes to literal address 0xe000000 via 0x08005384 -- this call pins the exact 32768-byte media size.

Generic software-DMA-queue fill (memset) primitive; also used for non-save VRAM/OAM/palette clears elsewhere in the ROM, so only its save-related call sites (from 0x08000c58 and 0x08000c9c ids 0x0E/0x0F) are treated as save I/O here.
Generic software-DMA-queue block copy; used by 0x080734cc for EWRAM-to-EWRAM 0x40-byte header staging copies. Also used for unrelated non-save transfers elsewhere, so not save-exclusive.

Generic id-keyed dispatcher (ids 0-0x10) shared across engine subsystems. Only ids 0x0E (full 32KB buffer op) and 0x0F (0x1220-byte per-slot op) are argued here to be save-specific, gated by a distinct 'SRAM op mode' flag.
Writes header fields (+0x08..+0x2F), computes header_sum32 over the pre-overwrite 64-byte header, stores checksum/complement at +0x00/+0x04, then calls 0x08000c9c(0) to stage/flush.

Per-candidate validator (checksum + complement + 20-byte magic string). Called 3x from 0x080734cc by direct address in decompiled.c, but this edge is absent from callgraph.json -- a known gap in the provided callgraph.

Top-level slot validate/select/commit orchestrator; no caller found anywhere in this workspace's 89-function corpus or callgraph.json (likely invoked from a save-trigger outside the provided function subset).
Boot-time SRAM presence/pattern self-test (via 0x0807443c) followed by staging the full buffer (id 0x0E) and per-slot buffer (id 0x0F), then calling 0x080734cc to validate/select.
